title: NY Government Web-Property Registry — Entity Record
description: One record describes a NYC or NYS government / public-authority ENTITY (not a single domain). An entity carries a stable BetaNYC id, a government-level classification, parent/child links, a list of web properties it has owned over its life, crosswalk ids into authoritative upstreams, and a jurisdiction pointer (by reference to BetaNYC/nyc-boundaries — never embedded geometry). Faithful to team/research/mayoral-executive-orders/2026-07-11-property-registry-design.md §2.

betanyc_id.description: Our own stable key, because no single upstream spans city + state + bi-state + authority. Format BNYC-ORG-NNNNNN. Immutable, never reused (same discipline as MODA's record_id and the EO project's synthetic eo_id).

name.description: Official / preferred name of the entity.

government_level.description: Coarse classification, LOCKED enum (STATUS.md, 2026-07-11). nyc = NYC city entity; nys = NYS state executive agency; bi-state = entity whose jurisdiction spans NY and another state (e.g. PANYNJ); authority = public authority (state/local/IDA/LDC); pbc = public-benefit corporation. NOTE: authority and pbc overlap by design; entity_type carries the finer legal-instrument detail. See docs/schema.md § government_level for the reconciliation with the design doc's richer vocab and open question O1.

entity_type.description: Finer legal / organizational classification, free-text or upstream-derived (e.g. 'public-benefit-corporation', 'mayoral-agency', 'local-development-corporation', 'public-university'). Mirrors MODA's organization_type where the entity is a city org.

parent_id.description: betanyc_id of the parent entity (e.g. the MTA is parent of LIRR / Metro-North / NYCT / TBTA), or null for a top-level entity.

child_ids.description: betanyc_ids of subsidiary entities. Bidirectional with parent_id.

crosswalk.description: The interoperability core. Every field may be null. Values are populated ONLY when verified against the upstream — never invented (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

moda_govid.description: MODA record_id (the immutable primary key of MODA-NYC/nyc-governance-organizations). Joins the city registry. Null for non-city entities.

abo_id.description: Stable authority id from the ABO Directory of Public Authorities. NOTE: the documented 9-column dataset 4vym-q77x does NOT expose an explicit id column; abo_id resolution is unconfirmed (see docs/sources.md § ABO). Null until confirmed.

wikidata_qid.description: Wikidata QID (joins the open-knowledge graph; often carries P856 official-website). Null until verified.

irs_ein.description: IRS Employer Identification Number for the .org public-benefit corps (H+H, some LDCs). Joins IRS/Candid nonprofit data. Null until verified. Never invented.

opendata_dataset.description: Optional: the entity's own Socrata dataset id where one exists (design doc §2). Null where none.

web_properties.description: The heart of the harvester config: the domains/subdomains an entity has owned over its life. A list because entities accrete and retire domains.

domain.description: Registrable domain or subdomain (e.g. 'mta.info', 'web.mta.info'). Not a full URL and not a path.

role.description: primary = the entity's current canonical site; legacy = a retired/superseded host; microsite = a campaign/sub-brand site.

valid_from.description: Year 'YYYY' or ISO date the property came into use, or null if unknown.

valid_to.description: Year 'YYYY' or ISO date the property was retired, or null if still active / unknown.

url_conventions.description: Per-era path patterns under a domain (the harvester reads these to know WHERE under a domain documents historically lived).

era.description: Year range the pattern applied, e.g. '2003-2020'.

jurisdiction.description: Geography by REFERENCE only. Geometry is never embedded here (design doc §3).

boundary_ref.description: Pointer into BetaNYC/nyc-boundaries: {layer, id}. Set ONLY for entities that map cleanly onto an existing nyc-boundaries layer; null otherwise. Never invent a boundary id.

layer.description: nyc-boundaries layer code (e.g. 'cc' council district, 'cd' community district, or 'citywide').

id.description: District Unique Identifier within the layer; null for a whole-layer / 'citywide' reference.

coverage.description: Coarse jurisdictional extent, used where boundary_ref cannot map cleanly to nyc-boundaries.

boundary_note.description: For jurisdictions that EXCEED nyc-boundaries (MTA regional service area, bi-state PANYNJ, statewide agencies): a note naming the candidate external geometry source. No geometry is stored.

established_by_eo.description: EO linkage. Where an executive order created or established this entity, each element references the order by the LOCKED cross-link field names (STATUS.md 'Cross-link field names — LOCKED'). The reciprocal direction lives on the EO record as establishes_entity = this entity's betanyc_id.

eo_id.description: LOCKED: stable synthetic identifier for a single executive order (per-mayor numbering resets, so the raw EO number is not unique across administrations).

source_pdf_url.description: LOCKED: resolved live-or-Wayback URL of the order's source PDF; the canonical PDF pointer in the EO corpus.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Removals/renames from an upstream are recorded as status changes + valid_to, never silent deletes (design doc §4).

valid_from.description: Year 'YYYY' or ISO date the entity was established, or null if unknown.

valid_to.description: Year 'YYYY' or ISO date the entity was dissolved/merged/renamed, or null if still active.

succeeds_ids.description: betanyc_ids of predecessor entities this one succeeds (e.g. OTI succeeds DoITT).

provenance.description: Which upstreams asserted this record and when it was last verified, so a hand-curated record and an auto-synced record are distinguishable.

last_verified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) this record was last verified.
